## Profile

Spatial data science and public health professional specializing in GIS, integrated pest management, and UAS/remote sensing. My work focuses on turning surveillance and environmental data into practical tools that support vector-borne disease prevention, integrated pest management, regulatory compliance, and defensible public health operations.

## Focus areas

- Spatial data science for vector surveillance and public health decision support
- GIS, geodatabases, dashboards, and field data systems for integrated pest management operations
- UAS, photogrammetry, LiDAR, and remote sensing
- Mosquito surveillance, arbovirus monitoring, treatment thresholds, and vector species distribution analysis
- Reproducible workflows, automated data pipelines, and applied analytics.

## Current role

**Director of Technical Development**  
Collier Mosquito Control District, Naples, Florida  
March 2023--present

Lead GIS, data analytics, UAS, and technical development initiatives supporting integrated mosquito management and public health operations. Responsibilities include ArcGIS Online administration, spatial data infrastructure, operational dashboards, custom GIS tools, UAS program management, regulatory reporting, and applied research involving vector species composition and distribution.

Selected work includes:

- Administering the District's ArcGIS Online platform, including dashboards, web applications, data integrity, security, and performance
- Directing development of custom GIS software tools, web applications, and data pipelines for integrated mosquito management operations
- Leading spatial analysis and data science projects focused on vector species composition, distribution, and operational decision support
- Managing UAS inspections, remote-sensing missions, and treatment workflows
- Preparing FDACS and FAA reports, summary metrics, and compliance documentation
- Evaluating and implementing emerging technologies to improve mosquito control operations and public health outcomes

## Technical skills

**GIS and geospatial systems:** ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Online, Survey123 Connect, Field Maps, Experience Builder, QGIS, geodatabases, operational dashboards, web mapping, field data collection workflows

**Spatial data science and analytics:** R, Python, tidyverse suite of packages, ggplot2, ArcGIS API for Python, arcpy, Jupyter Notebooks, GeoPandas, sf

**Remote sensing and UAS:** UAS operations, photogrammetry, LiDAR, drone inspections, aerial imagery, treatment missions, regulatory compliance, crew resource management

**Vector surveillance and public health operations:** mosquito surveillance, adult and larval surveillance, traps, mosquito identification, pooling, RT-PCR testing support, arbovirus surveillance, treatment thresholds

**Operational analytics and IPM:** treatment tracking, aerial application analytics, equipment calibration, swath analysis, logistical planning, regulatory reporting, workflow automation

**Visualization and communication:** Quarto, ArcGIS dashboards, Leaflet, MapLibre, Shiny, Observable, technical reporting, training, presentations, and outreach

## Teaching and workshops

Rosales, A. (January 2026). Integrated Pest Management. Advanced Mosquito Control, DODD Short Courses, Florida Mosquito Control Association.
Focuses on the history of integrated pest management in the US, surveillance-driven decision-making, establishing treatment thresholds, and leveraging freely accessible GIS data for enhancing integrated mosquito management practices.

Rosales, A. (January 2026). Mosquito Surveillance and Identification. Introduction to Mosquito Control, DODD Short Courses, Florida Mosquito Control Association.
Focuses on adult and larval surveillance, trap deployment and use-cases, specimen handling, mosquito ID, data quality, and the public health role of surveillance.

Rosales, A., & Lefkow, N. (January 2024). Unmanned Aerial Systems (UAS) for Mosquito Control: Regulations, Operations, and Best Practices. DODD Short Courses, Florida Mosquito Control Association.

Rosales, A. (January 2022). Taking on Tables: Intermediate Excel for the Mosquito Control Professional. DODD Short Courses, Florida Mosquito Control Association.
